options.summary: Links go in CDATA fields only; the arc-meta SKILL.md sentence says so; no code change, the href in a <para> is still dropped without a report.
check_canonical reports an element child of <para> (such as <a>) as unsupported_para_markup, so the author moves the field to CDATA; writers unchanged. Adds a TASK-2 node.
inner_html (and arc-help-pages' own <para> reader) serialize child elements, so <a> in a <para> passes through like CDATA. Adds TASK-1 and TASK-5 nodes.

decisions.rationale: A <para> stays plain text; check_canonical names the dropped markup so the author moves the field to CDATA, and no reader changes. The developer accepted this recommendation on 2026-11-09 (relayed by the coordinator).

decisions.question: A tool.content parameter with no <param> in the canonical XML: the spec orders rows by tool.content but does not say what a row without canonical attributes shows.

options.summary: tool_doc raises HelpError naming the parameter; arc-meta's check_canonical already reports it as missing_param.
A row with the name and the tool.content datatype and 'No description.'.

decisions.rationale: A help page row nobody wrote text for publishes an unchecked gap; the fix is in the canonical XML, which arc-meta's check_canonical names (missing_param, arc_meta_api.py:214-216). Confirmed by the developer on 2026-11-09 (relayed by the coordinator).

decisions.question: Relative hrefs in check_links (review R5): an href that is not '#...', has no scheme and is not absolute (docs/demo.html, ../x.html) resolves against Pro's temp copy of the '?' page and breaks; the spec's Section 3 Checks name no code for it.

options.summary: A new HelpProblemCode link_relative reports each one.
check_links skips them, as it skips web links.
Report them as link_outside_checkout.

decisions.rationale: A relative href is dead on the '?' page, and its own code tells the author to write the development href instead. The developer accepted this recommendation on 2026-11-09 (relayed by the coordinator).

decisions.question: Section 2 ships first (review R3): the spec's Order of work puts the Gate between Section 2 and Section 3, so the arc-meta change can ship and be clicked in Pro before arc-help-pages exists.

options.summary: PR A = TASK-1 to TASK-3.1 (arc-straps 0.1.0 -> 0.2.0); PR B = TASK-4 to TASK-9 (0.2.0 -> 0.3.0), started after the Gate passes.
One pull request for Sections 2 and 3, one bump to 0.2.0.

decisions.rationale: The Gate can stop Section 3; a separate PR A ships the link pass-through the Gate needs without waiting on, or being reverted with, arc-help-pages. The developer accepted this recommendation on 2026-11-09 (relayed by the coordinator).
